p: months in Jerusalem: Three months after the death of Josiah, Necho came to Jerusalem, and so the plagues began, which Huldah and the prophets forewarned would come on Jerusalem.
hundred talents of silver and a: To pay this as a yearly tribute.
evil in the sight of the: Because he and the people did not turn to God by his first plague, he brought a new one on him, and at length rooted them out.

that which was found in him: He means superstitious marks which were found on his body when he was dead, which declared how deeply idolatry was rooted in his heart, seeing he bore the marks in his flesh.

eight years old when he began: That is, he began his reign at eight years old, and reigned ten years when his father was alive, and after his father's death, which was in his eighteenth year, he reigned alone three months and ten days.
rising up betimes: By this phrase the scripture means often and diligently as in Jer 11:7,25:3,26:5,32:33.
remedy: Till God could no longer allow their sins, but must punish them.
in the house of their sanctuary: Where they fled, thinking to have been saved for the holiness of it.

gave them all into his hand: Which is not because God approves him, who yet is the minister of his justice, but because God would by his just judgment punish this people: for this king was led with ambition and vain glory, to which were joined fury and cruelty: therefore his work was condemnable, even though it was just and holy on God's part, who used this wicked instrument to declare his justice.
Persia: When Gyrus king of Persia had made the Babylonians subject.
mouth of Jeremiah: Who threatened the vengeance of God and 70 years captivity, which he called the sabbaths or rest of the land, Jer 25:11.
first year of Cyrus king of: In the first year that he reigned over the Chaldeans, Ezr 1:1.

charged me to build him an: God had so forewarned by his prophet over 100 years before Cyrus was born, Isa 44:28 that Jerusalem and the temple would be rebuilt by Cyrus his anointed: so called because God used his service for a time to deliver his Church.
